lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple columns of high-intensity white circular pixel clusters arranged in a grid-like formation posterior to the gill slits, with increasing spatial separation along the longitudinal axis towards the caudal region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated luminance intersecting with the primary circular blobs to form a regular series of nodes along the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A subtle horizontal linear feature visible along the upper flank, defined by a slight shadow gradient immediately ventral to the dorsal-most row of high-intensity spots.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-density distribution of significantly smaller high-luminance spots compared to the larger blobs on the lateral flank.
